question: Find the display name of the owner of the most valuable post (by favorite count) among those tagged with 'machine-learning', where the owner has a reputation over 2000 and joined before 2012. Additionally, only consider posts that have at least one comment containing a URL.

prediction.sql: SELECT u.XCL_055 FROM posts AS p JOIN tags AS t ON t.XCL_050 = p.XCL_026 JOIN users AS u ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033 WHERE t.XCL_048 = 'machine-learning' AND u.XCL_053 > 2000 AND u.XCL_054 < '2012-01-01' AND p.XCL_026 IN (SELECT c.XCL_006 FROM comments AS c WHERE c.XCL_008 LIKE '%http%') ORDER BY p.XCL_039 DESC LIMIT 1

measures.multiplicity_argument: one row per post, no duplication from joins

arguments.sql:
SELECT u.XCL_055
FROM posts p
JOIN tags t ON t.XCL_050 = p.XCL_026
JOIN users u ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033
WHERE t.XCL_048 = 'machine-learning'
  AND u.XCL_053 > 2000
  AND u.XCL_054 < '2012-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM comments c
    WHERE c.XCL_006 = p.XCL_026
      AND c.XCL_008 LIKE '%http%'
  )
ORDER BY p.XCL_039 DESC
LIMIT 1;
